items.desc: Italian photographer Federico Veronesi’s image, taken in Namibia, highlights the complex ways elephants respond to death.

items.desc: The 71-year-old pontiff has lung adenocarcinoma, with doctors removing the lower lobe of his right lung in a procedure they said was successful.

items.title: Movie review: ‘The Social Reckoning’ is an analogue call-to-action for a digital dystopia
items.desc: One might get a sense that the movie doesn’t have a full handle on the mayhem Facebook has caused. Or Aaron Sorkin didn’t think it would make for compelling cinema.

items.title: Flood cuts off northern Gorkha’s lifeline, disrupts Manaslu trekking season
items.desc: Five bridges and key roads and trails have been washed away, damaging tourism businesses and leaving trekkers stranded.

items.desc: The party has barred him from duties as lawmaker and central committee member, while police await a formal complaint before launching a criminal investigation.

items.title: Nepal seeks German Embassy’s help to resolve passport payment dispute
items.desc: The government has withheld Rs300 million owed to Muehlbauer because of a corruption case against the German firm. This has put passport services at risk.

items.title: RSP must rein in its lawmakers and hold them accountable
items.desc: The party swiftly investigated the allegations against Sunar. Now it must deliver tangible results.

items.desc: Recurring disasters in Nepal destroy crops, permanently erode farmland, displace families and worsen economic inequality.

items.desc: The government must immediately secure clean water, enforce emergency sanitation and monitor emerging infections.

items.desc: The finance minister is scheduled to hold more than 16 bilateral and multilateral meetings on Nepal’s economic priorities and development financing.
